params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$dir='C:\Users\Xxkan\actions-runner-heaven'
$meta=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir '.runner') | ConvertFrom-Json
$procs=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @('Runner.Listener.exe','Runner.Worker.exe') } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine,CreationDate)
$logs=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir '_diag') -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTimeUtc -Descending | Select-Object -First 4)
$tails=@()
foreach($log in $logs){
  $lines=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath $log.FullName -Tail 100 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
  $tails += [pscustomobject]@{name=$log.Name;lastWriteUtc=$log.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('o');tail=($lines -join [Environment]::NewLine)}
}
[pscustomobject]@{agentId=$meta.agentId;agentName=$meta.agentName;poolId=$meta.poolId;serverUrl=$meta.serverUrl;workFolder=$meta.workFolder;processes=$procs;logs=$tails} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress
